_comment: Hand-maintained directory of courts: where each one posts calendars, live audio/video and recordings. Not touched by the daily job. 'calendar_status': built = this site reads the court's calendar; sessions = only sitting days; manual = read only when the site owner asks (see calendar_note).

courts.name: Supreme Court of the United States
courts.listen_note: Live audio from the Court's home page during argument; recordings are posted the same day.

courts.name: U.S. Court of Appeals for the First Circuit
courts.listen_note: Live audio on the court's YouTube channel; recordings posted after argument.

courts.name: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit
courts.listen_note: Live audio on one YouTube channel per courtroom; recordings posted after argument.
courts.calendar_note: The 2nd Circuit's calendar system (HuntCal) asks automated readers not to visit it, so its cases are refreshed only when the site owner asks, not automatically. The court's calendar page is always current.

courts.name: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit
courts.listen_note: Live audio on YouTube; audio and video recordings posted after argument.

courts.name: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit
courts.listen_note: Live audio on the court's livestream page; recordings posted after argument.

courts.name: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit
courts.listen_note: One live audio feed per courtroom; the full recording is posted shortly after argument.

courts.name: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit
courts.listen_note: Live audio on the court's Live Arguments page; audio files posted after argument.
courts.calendar_note: Sitting weeks come from the court's yearly schedule; case lists are posted about two weeks ahead.

courts.name: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit
courts.listen_note: Live on YouTube; audio recordings posted after argument. The calendar runs 30 days ahead.

courts.name: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit
courts.listen_note: No livestream: the court posts a public listen-in phone number in its news before each session. MP3 archive after argument.

courts.name: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit
courts.listen_note: Every argument is streamed live on YouTube; video archive on the court's site.

courts.name: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit
courts.listen_note: Live audio on the court's YouTube channel; recording archive on its site.

courts.name: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit
courts.listen_note: Each session has its own live stream (linked next to its calendar); recordings posted after argument.

courts.name: U.S. Court of Appeals for the D.C. Circuit
courts.listen_note: Live audio of every argument (from today's sitting page and YouTube); recordings posted after argument.
courts.calendar_note: The court's calendar pages ask automated readers not to visit them (robots.txt), so its cases are refreshed only when the site owner asks, not automatically. The court's own pages are always current.

courts.name: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit
courts.listen_note: Live audio on YouTube starting shortly before each panel; recordings posted the same day.
